title: dns/register output
description: Output Contract for the dns/register Action (ADR-0144): the record as WRITTEN — canonicalized (lowercased, qualified, TTL defaulted), so a descent screen shows what actually landed in the zone rather than what was typed. Deliberately NOT a reach coordinate: mgmt.address comes from the Syncer reading the zone back, never from a build asserting what it intended (ADR-0144 D5).

name.description: The fully-qualified owner name as written.

data.description: The record data as written (address canonicalized, CNAME target lowercased).
